FFmpeg runtime license notice

Release builds replace this file with the exact FFmpeg version, checksum,
source location, and platform-specific dependency details. Kosmos only ships
LGPL-compatible FFmpeg builds; GPL and non-free components are disabled on
macOS, and Windows uses a pinned BtbN LGPL shared build.

FFmpeg license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

macOS release assets include the matching FFmpeg source archive. Windows
release assets identify the exact FFmpeg source commit in this file.
